items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: Ori goes out, comes out to Los Angeles, and he meets up with a dude, he called Lee Lockin.

ctx.x: Yeah. So, Ori put, they had a supper, and long table, and waitin', little piggy around there. Nah, they had to sway in. They all got all that mean to the sport. Johnny Topp, and Lewis, and Joe Lindsey. You want to see, I said, listen. I said, I didn't tell them I was going to promise them. My mother. You going? I said, yeah, I'm going. I tell you, stop going. All right. Ori left on a Friday night. They went by the train. I couldn't make it that Friday night to see you all. Ori goes out, comes out to Los Angeles,…
